# What A Rush Riding Stables & House of Grace

> Beachfront horseback riding, guided trail rides, horsemanship lessons, horse therapy, and beachfront palapa rental in Playa Cangrejera, La Libertad, El Salvador. Operated by Shawn and D'Arcy Burke with 30+ years of horsemanship experience.

---

## About What A Rush

What A Rush is a beachfront horseback riding and adventure experience center located in Playa Cangrejera, La Libertad, El Salvador. Visitors can experience the thrill of beachfront horseback riding through scenic sugar cane fields, estuaries, and guided wooded trail rides. The stables are operated by Shawn and D'Arcy Burke, who bring over 30 years of horsemanship experience and training to every ride.

What A Rush also operates House of Grace, a beachfront palapa (beach hut) available for short-term and long-term rental, offering a perfect blend of adventure and luxury on the beautiful beaches of La Libertad.

---

## Our Horses

### Sir Dante
Breed: Black Beauty gelding
Skill Level: Beginners and advanced riders
Description: Regal in appearance and a presence that says "Look at Me!" He is a real head turner that moves like fluid grace. Level headed, calm, collected and responsive with a willing attitude to serve. This well mannered Black Beauty gelding is very intuitive to his rider. He is certain to appeal to beginners as well as advanced equine riders. He makes all of his riders look amazing.

### Paco
Breed: Peruvian Horse (gaited)
Skill Level: Intermediate or first-time riders
Description: A gentle gaited Peruvian Horse with a heart of a champion. Paco offers a smooth, almost hovercraft-like ride over the terrain. Perfect for intermediate or first-time riders. Paco will make you passionate about riding because he is a pure joy to ride.

### Congrejeto
Breed: Friesian Horse
Skill Level: Beginners and intermediate riders
Description: An elegant strided Friesian Horse. This species is known for their Knights in Shining Armor heritage. They are the most handsome of horses. Gentle and patient - ideal for beginners and intermediate riders. Calm demeanor, safe and confident riding experience.

### Tequilla
Breed: Spanish gaited horse
Skill Level: Experienced equestrians
Description: A Spanish gaited horse with spirit and endurance. He is bold, beautiful with flowing mane and best suited for experienced equestrians who have practiced harmony with horses and who enjoy the thrill of the ride.

### Victorioso
Breed: Not specified
Skill Level: Riders seeking adventure
Description: Known for his power and fluid grace. He combines strength with elegance like poetry in motion. This magnificent horse is perfect for riders seeking adventure and a rewarding experience as you connect with nature and beauty.

### Carbonero
Breed: Spanish gaited horse
Skill Level: All levels
Description: Wise and experienced Spanish gaited horse. This guy offers an enjoyable nature ride on the back of a smooth operator. Carbonero is very intuitive and aware of his rider. He enjoys the ride as much as his rider does. He is steady, calm, and reliable.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What types of horseback riding experiences do you offer?
We offer guided trail rides through sugar cane fields, estuaries, and wooded trails ($60 USD), horse/human therapy sessions, horsemanship training lessons, and structured riding lessons for all skill levels.

### Do I need riding experience?
No. We have horses suited for all experience levels. Sir Dante, Paco and Congrejeto are perfect for beginners and advanced riders alike, while Tequilla is ideal for experienced riders.

### Where are you located?
We are located at Playa Cangrejera, La Libertad, El Salvador. Look for the yellow sign.

### How do I book a ride or rental?
Contact Shawn Burke via WhatsApp at +503 6986 6030 or visit https://wa.me/50369866030.

### What is the palapa rental?
House of Grace is a fully furnished beachfront palapa with 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, Starlink internet, and pool access. Nightly rates start at $250 USD.

### Do you accept Bitcoin?
Yes, we accept both cash and Bitcoin as payment methods.

### What equipment is provided for trail rides?
All necessary tack and equipment is provided for guided trail rides.

### Is internet available at the rental?
Yes, Starlink Internet is included with the palapa rental.
